title: Canonical equivalence relations on $\mathrm{FIN}^{[\infty]}_2$
summary: Answering a question of Todorcevic, we prove higher-dimensional canonization theorems for the topological Ramsey space $\mathrm{FIN}^{[\infty]}_2$. Our results build upon the work of Lopez-Abad and continue the line of research initiated by Erdős and Rado, and further developed by Pudlák and Rödl, Prömel and Voigt, Taylor, and Klein and Spinas.
